subject: Joint model: compund symmtery and correlated random effects

messages.author: 78f18e5a32647f45
messages.subject: Joint model: compund symmtery and correlated random effects
parts:
Dear INLA community

I want to fit a joint Binomial-Poisson areal model with this definition :

r_ij  ~ Binomial (n_ij, p_ij )

logit⁡(p_ij)= β_0,1 + β_1,1[agecat_1]_ij + β_2,1[agecat_2]_ij + ν_(i,1) + γ_(j,1)

O_ij  ~ Poisson (N_ij,IR_ij )

log⁡(IR_ij)= β_0,2+β_1,2 [agecat_1]_ij + β_2,2[agecat_2]_ij + ν_(i,2) + γ_(j,2)

with ν_(i,1) & ν_(i,2) spatial structured random effect, γ_(j,1) & γ_(j,2) temporal structured random effect, i = areal unit (1,...,93), and j = temporal unit (1,...,16).

I plan to compare different structures of the variance-covariance matrix of the random effects, in particular, the compound symmetry model and correlated random effects. If I understand correctly I can model the compound symmetry using the 'group' option:

mod.compund <- Y ~ -1 + intercept +
  cov.bin + cov.pois +
  f(idarea2, model = "besag", graph = gDIST, group = g.nu) +
  f(idperiod2, model = "rw1", group = g.gamma)

My question will be, how I can fit the correlated random effects with the below matrix? Is it still using the 'group' option?


Thank you.

Kind regards,
Yessika

Dear Haavard

I have a follow-up question about this topic. When I ran the example code I received this summary:

Model hyperparameters: mean sd 0.025quant 0.5quant 0.975quant mode Rho for idx 0.858 0.010 0.838 0.858 0.876 0.859 GroupRho for idx 0.750 0.023 0.703 0.751 0.792 0.753 Beta for idx2 1.815 0.061 1.695 1.815 1.936 1.815

I assume that Rho is the correlation from 'ar1' model and GroupRho is the correlation parameter between idx and idx2. How to interpret Beta in this case? Will it be a scaling parameter for GroupRho, so the final correlation will be Beta*GroupRho? Or is Beta still the scaling parameter for the idx2 random effect?

Thank you.

Kind regards,
Yessika

> Dear Haavard

> I have a follow-up question about this topic. When I ran the example
> code I received this summary:
>
> Model hyperparameters: mean sd 0.025quant 0.5quant 0.975quant mode Rho
> for idx 0.858 0.010 0.838 0.858 0.876 0.859 GroupRho for idx 0.750
> 0.023 0.703 0.751 0.792 0.753 Beta for idx2 1.815 0.061 1.695 1.815
> 1.936 1.815
>
> I assume that Rho is the correlation from 'ar1' model and GroupRho is
> the correlation parameter between idx and idx2.
yes

> How to interpret Beta in this case? Will it be a scaling parameter for
> GroupRho, so the final correlation will be Beta*GroupRho? Or is Beta
> still the scaling parameter for the idx2 random effect?

Beta is the scaling of the copy, and Beta^2 scales the variance of idx2
compared to idx.
